applicabilityBasis.summary: IDRX is a 1:1 IDR-backed, redeemable stablecoin explicitly marketed for global payments and transfers.

genius.notes: IDRX's May 4, 2026 terms explicitly identify PT IDRX Indo Inovasi, established under Indonesian law, as the token issuer. The website markets fixed-rate IDR redemption and payment/transfer use, and redemption documentation describes burning tokens through the platform followed by IDR bank payment. The website excludes U.S. customer access; that restriction and the IDR denomination do not themselves exclude the token from the statutory functional definition. No qualifying public GENIUS approval, application, state qualification, foreign registration or announced GENIUS route was located in the listed public sources as of 2026-10-07. The issuer's document index contains repeated monthly reserve reports; the reopened August report is an agreed-upon-procedures report. An assurance-type or mandatory monthly-attestation conclusion is not assigned. The S3 report fetch aborted, so reserveDisclosureUrl uses the reopened base-linked Google Storage mirror of the August 28 report. DASP posture concerns the GENIUS implementation timeline only, not permission under other law. Enforcement status is omitted because the bounded search does not support a high-confidence comprehensive action-history conclusion.

sourcesChecked: OCC digital-assets licensing tracker: complete nine-applicant HTML table reopened with plain HTTPS extraction; no IDRX or PT IDRX Indo Inovasi match. This is a charter tracker, not an exhaustive GENIUS register.
Federal Register API exact IDRX query, publication date through 2026-10-07: zero documents.
NYDFS complete regulated-entity directory and Greenlist: no IDRX or PT IDRX Indo Inovasi match; ordinary state licensing would not establish GENIUS qualification.

OCC Bulletin 2026-3, Federal Register June 22 CIP proposal, Treasury April 8 AML/CFT proposal, August 17 issuance/offer/sale proposal, September 30 SCRC procedural rule and Federal Reserve September 24 proposals: implementation context, no IDRX authorization.

IDRX current website, May 4 terms, redemption documentation, transparency document API and August reserve-report mirror: token identity, payment/redemption use and public disclosures; no GENIUS statement.

Named IDRX/PT IDRX Indo Inovasi searches across OCC, Federal Register, NYDFS, FDIC, Federal Reserve, FinCEN, SEC and CFTC domains: no relevant qualifying token-specific record located; generic unrelated results were excluded.
negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, no qualifying public GENIUS approval, official application, state qualification, registered foreign exception or issuer-announced route for IDRX or PT IDRX Indo Inovasi was found in the opened issuer disclosures, OCC tracker, Federal Register exact-name query, NYDFS directory and scoped official-domain searches. The finding is limited to these public sources and does not rule out a confidential or unpublished filing.
